components.css: .ds-plate{position:relative;display:inline-block;min-width:264px;padding:16px 20px 14px;border-radius:var(--mv-radius-plate,20px);background:var(--mv-plate-bone,#ece6da);color:var(--mv-plate-ink,#121315);overflow:hidden;animation:ds-settle 240ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) both}.ds-stripe{position:absolute;top:14px;right:-46px;width:140px;height:9px;background:var(--mv-copper,#d4622e);transform:rotate(45deg);animation:ds-lay 420ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1) 120ms both}.ds-stripe::after{content:'';position:absolute;top:13px;left:0;width:100%;height:4.5px;background:var(--mv-bg,#111214)}.ds-fig{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:8px;font-family:var(--mv-font-display,'Barlow Condensed','Arial Narrow',sans-serif)}.ds-n{font-weight:600;font-size:40px;line-height:42px;font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums}.ds-u{font-weight:500;font-size:20px;line-height:22px}.ds-cap{margin-top:4px;font:500 15px/20px var(--mv-font-body,-apple-system,sans-serif)}.ds-edge{display:flex;gap:8px;margin-top:10px;padding-top:8px;border-top:1px solid rgba(18,19,21,.16);font:13px/18px var(--mv-font-body,-apple-system,sans-serif)}.ds-edge b{font-family:var(--mv-font-display,'Barlow Condensed',sans-serif);font-weight:700}.ds-edge span{font-weight:500;color:rgba(18,19,21,.68)}@keyframes ds-settle{from{transform:scale(.98)}to{transform:scale(1)}}@keyframes ds-lay{from{transform:rotate(45deg) translateX(120%)}to{transform:rotate(45deg) translateX(0)}}@media (prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.ds-plate,.ds-stripe{animation:none}}

narrative.overview:
**Creative North Star: "Trackside"**

The web is the Race Plate world (`apps/mobile/DESIGN.md`) seen from the edge of the track: a full-bleed ride photograph carries the emotion, and everything else speaks in the plate's voice. The one object the site shares with the app is the Bike Plate, a rounded panel whose fill is a bike's readiness, drawn exactly as the app draws it, including on the home hero.

Around the plate the site is quiet and mechanical. A graphite ramp with bone ink is the default; a warm paper ramp with near-black ink is the light scheme, and both are first-class. Barlow Condensed carries headlines and numbers; every sentence, label and button is the system face. Copper is reserved for the act: the primary button, the link, the current selection. Content sits on the page, separated by spacing and hairlines rather than cards, and surfaces lift by stepping up the ramp rather than by casting shadows.

The world retires the earlier editorial web (serif display, mono labels, warm-gradient copper, eyebrows above titles) and borrows nothing from it. The livery stripe on the plate is the one diagonal on any viewport.
keyCharacteristics: One token source: `packages/design-system/src/mv-tokens.css`. Dark on `:root`, light on `html:not(.dark)`; the theme provider toggles the class and a pre-paint script resolves storage, then OS preference.
The Bike Plate is the signature; its triad colours appear nowhere else.
Condensed numerals and headlines against a native system face.
Flat and tonal: no card shadows, blur budget spent on the navbar only.
Hairline rows and spec tables instead of cards; at most one card-styled element per section.
Motion is visible-by-default and transform-only; one authored moment per page.

rules.name: The Copper Is a Verb Rule
rules.body: Copper marks a primary action, a link or the current selection. Never status, never a heading accent, never gradient text, never a glow (no copper box-shadow). The livery stripe is the plate's own device, not decoration.

rules.name: The Triad Belongs to State Rule
rules.body: Bone, signal and red appear only inside depictions of the app: the Bike Plate and app screenshots.

rules.name: The Both-Schemes Rule
rules.body: Every colour is a `var(--mv-*)` with a value in both schemes. Text inks clear 4.5:1 on ground, card and raised in each; due/overdue/go shift to darker inks in light.

rules.name: The Condensed Means Number Rule
rules.body: `--mv-font-display` sets H1, H2, H3 and figures, with tabular numerals for every figure, table cell and row aside. Every sentence, label and button is `--mv-font-body`.

rules.name: The Plain Voice Rule
rules.body: Sentence case everywhere, headings and buttons included. No eyebrows or kickers above titles, no section numbers, no letter-spaced uppercase, no italic display, no serif, no mono labels. A status line sits under a title, never above it.

rules.name: The Ramp Is the Shadow Rule
rules.body: No drop shadows on cards or rows; no blur outside the navbar.

rules.name: The One Signature Motion
rules.body: `data-settle` makes the plate settle (scale 0.98 → 1 over `dur-3`, expo ease) and, 120ms in, the livery stripe slides along its own 45° axis into place over `dur-4` (420ms). Transform only and clipped by the plate, so a stalled frame is a plate without its stripe, never a missing plate. `settle="late"` adds 240ms so the home hero reads photo settles, then stripe lays. One per page family, never inside `.mv-reveal`; used on the home hero and the Pro checkout success page. A state change cross-fades the fill over `dur-3`.

dos: **Do** read every colour, radius, font, easing and duration from `var(--mv-*)` in `mv-tokens.css`, and check the result in dark and light.
**Do** show readiness with `<BikePlate>` (triad fill, plate ink), and give it the settle on at most one plate per page family.
**Do** use copper only for the primary action, a link, the focus ring or the current selection, with `on-copper` as its ink.
**Do** set H1/H2/H3 and every figure in Barlow Condensed with tabular numerals, and every sentence, label and button in the system face.
**Do** snap type to the steps above (13 floor, 15 workhorse, 16 inputs) and spacing to 4–160 as listed.
**Do** separate content with spacing and hairline rows; keep to one card-styled element per section.
**Do** keep every target at 44px and every shell inside the 1240px container with the 40 / 24 / 20 gutter.
**Do** wrap any band over a dark photograph in `.mv-dark-scene`, and offset fixed bottom bars by `--mv-cookie-banner-h`.
**Do** keep entrances transform/opacity only, visible by default, and honour `prefers-reduced-motion`.
donts: **Don't** use bone, signal or red outside a depiction of the app, or use copper for status, headings, gradients or glows.
**Don't** add drop shadows to cards or rows, or blur anywhere but the scrolled navbar.
**Don't** place an eyebrow, kicker or section number above a title, or set labels in letter-spaced uppercase, serif, italic display or mono.
**Don't** add a second diagonal; the livery stripe is the only one, at most one per viewport.
**Don't** use more than one full device frame per page, or identical icon-tile grids.
**Don't** add infinite loops, parallax, magnetic buttons or scroll-scrubbed scenes; the loader is the only loop.

**Don't** use Tailwind palette classes or raw hex in Trackside surfaces, or the deprecated aliases (`--mv-warm-*`, `--mv-page`, `--mv-card`, `--mv-copper-400/500/600`, `--mv-font-sans/serif`, `--mv-on-accent`, `--mv-success/warning/danger`).
